The second-place hypothesis (p=0.24, environmental undersampling) requires I know the trial cadence in seconds—I have NOT yet measured it directly. Running 12 more trials and timing them precisely will bound that parameter. This is methodical and directly addresses the question that will either validate or eliminate the leading hypothesis.
